items.question: I'm new here - where do I begin?
items.answer: Welcome to NISH! Complete your onboarding steps, receive your equipment, and confirm your personal details. If you are unsure where to start, contact hr@nishtech.be.
items.searchText: I'm new here where do I begin onboarding contract equipment hr nish

items.question: What is NEPtune?
items.answer: NEPtune is the internal employee portal used for timesheets, leave applications, and day-to-day HR tasks. Your login is shared during onboarding.
items.searchText: what is neptune employee portal timesheets leave onboarding login

items.question: How do I update my personal details?
items.answer: Complete the personal details form from your onboarding pack or email hr@nishtech.be with your updated address, bank details, or family information.
items.searchText: update personal details address bank family hr

items.question: Can I work from home?
items.answer: Telework is possible by agreement with NISH and depends on your schedule, role, and client requirements. Coordinate with hr@nishtech.be before changing your working pattern.
items.searchText: work from home telework agreement schedule hr

items.question: How much annual holiday do I get?
items.answer: Full-time employees receive 20 paid holidays, plus 12 RTT/ADV days and Belgian public holidays, depending on your contract and leave balance.
items.searchText: annual holiday paid days rtt public holidays

items.question: How do I apply leave?
items.answer: Go to NEPtune and submit your leave request under Apply Leaves. Select the correct type, dates, and note any sick leave or medical certificate requirement.
items.searchText: apply leave neptune sick leave medical certificate

items.question: When and how am I paid?
items.answer: Salary is paid monthly by bank transfer. Keep your bank details updated and submit your timesheet on time so payroll can process your payment correctly.
items.searchText: when how paid monthly bank transfer payroll

items.question: Where can I see my payslip?
items.answer: Payslips are available through the SD Worx or mySDWorx portal. If you have access issues, contact payroll@nishtech.be.
items.searchText: where payslip sd worx mysdworx access payroll

items.question: How do meal vouchers work?
items.answer: Meal vouchers are loaded onto your voucher card and can be used for food and groceries up to the monthly allowance set by your benefits provider.
items.searchText: meal vouchers benefits allowance food groceries

items.question: Who provides my laptop?
items.answer: Depending on your assignment, the client or NISH may provide your laptop. If you have a device or access question, contact hr@nishtech.be.
items.searchText: who provides laptop client nish equipment

items.question: I have a login problem.
items.answer: For access issues with NEPtune, NConnect, email, or your workstation, contact hr@nishtech.be and include the issue you are facing.
items.searchText: login problem neptune nconnect email access

items.question: Can I get a certification reimbursed?
items.answer: Yes, continuing education and certified training may be supported with manager and HR approval. Contact lnd@nishtech.be for guidance.
items.searchText: certification reimbursement training lnd approval

items.question: What learning support is available?
items.answer: NISH encourages skill growth, knowledge sharing, and role-based learning. Ask your manager or contact lnd@nishtech.be for training options.
items.searchText: learning support knowledge sharing training courses

items.question: When do I submit my timesheet?
items.answer: Timesheets are generally submitted by the 23rd of the month. Make sure your working hours and assignment details are complete before you submit.
items.searchText: when submit timesheet monthly deadline 23rd

items.question: What if my hours are incorrect?
items.answer: Update the entry in NEPtune if needed or contact timesheets@nishtech.be for support.
items.searchText: incorrect hours timesheet correction contact

items.question: I need a proof of employment.
items.answer: Contact contracts@nishtech.be or hr@nishtech.be for proof of employment and contract-related documents.
items.searchText: proof of employment contract documents

items.question: Where can I find my contract details?
items.answer: Your active employment data is available in the contracts and HR systems. If you need a copy or change, contact the contracts mailbox.
items.searchText: contract details copy employment documents

items.question: Who do I contact for billing questions?
items.answer: Use invoices@nishtech.be for billing, expense, and invoicing questions.
items.searchText: billing invoicing expenses contact

items.question: What if my invoice is wrong?
items.answer: Send the invoice number, issue, and relevant documents to invoices@nishtech.be so the team can review it.
items.searchText: invoice wrong issue document review

items.question: How do I request a company car or mobility support?
items.answer: Mobility requests are reviewed based on role, policy, and eligibility. Contact fleet@nishtech.be for the process and documentation.
items.searchText: company car mobility support request fleet

items.question: What is the mobility budget?
items.answer: The mobility budget allows eligible employees to choose a sustainable transport or alternative mobility arrangement, depending on policy and package.
items.searchText: mobility budget sustainable transport alternative

items.question: Who handles client opportunities?
items.answer: Client opportunities and sales-related questions are handled by sales@nishtech.be.
items.searchText: client opportunities sales contact

items.question: How do I share a lead?
items.answer: Send the opportunity details, client context, and contact information to sales@nishtech.be.
items.searchText: share lead sales opportunity contact

items.question: How do I refer someone for a role?
items.answer: Send the candidate details and role information to jobs@nishtech.eu so the recruitment team can review it.
items.searchText: refer candidate role recruitment jobs

items.question: Where do I find open positions?
items.answer: Open roles are shared through the team communication channels and the recruitment mailbox. Contact jobs@nishtech.eu for more details.
items.searchText: open positions roles recruitment contact
